title: mal-agent: Evidence-Grounded Agentic Malware Triage with Bounded LLM Adjudication
description:
mal-agent is an evidence-grounded, agentic static malware analysis pipeline. Deterministic tools (PE/ELF/Mach-O parsing, capa capability detection, Authenticode verification, YARA matching, headless Ghidra decompilation, format-aware triage for scripts/LNK/Office/PDF, and a pretrained EMBER2024 classifier) produce a verdict a human can audit end to end: every claim traces to real tool evidence, and the classifier's decision authority is restricted to the file formats it was actually trained on.

An opt-in research mode (fusion_mode="judge") routes only the classifier's genuinely uncertain cases -- out-of-distribution formats, gray-zone scores, classifier-vs-evidence conflicts -- to a bounded LLM adjudicator that must cite tool-derived evidence and is structurally barred from treating the sample's own text as proof of its own innocence. See docs/RESEARCH.md for the full research design, dataset, and reproduction instructions, and paper/ for the accompanying write-up.
